hints.title: Recursive String Definition
hints.text: The string S_n has length 2^n - 1, with a fixed midpoint 1 at index 2^(n - 1).

hints.title: Midpoint Symmetry
hints.text: If k equals the midpoint 2^(n - 1), the bit is always "1". If k is less than midpoint, it equals the kth bit of S_(n - 1).

hints.title: Inversion and Reverse Property
hints.text: If k is greater than midpoint, it corresponds to the inverted bit at symmetric position 2^n - k in S_(n - 1).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing S_20 requires 2^20 characters (~1 million characters), which uses unnecessary memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursive index mapping solves the query in O(N) recursion steps without generating the string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes recursive symmetry and bit inversion without string materialization.
